name: deploy
description: Deploys a GitHub repository. If the repository has never been deployed in this workspace, this creates a new app and analyzes it; if it already maps to an existing app, this redeploys it. The caller does not need to know or specify which case applies.

backedBy.note: No single existing function does this today. Implementation composes analyzeSelectedRepository (customer-interface/src/server/repository-analysis.mjs) or redeployLiveCustomerApp (customer-deployments.mjs) for the create-vs-redeploy branch, then startCustomerDeployment once configuration is ready. Building that composition is item 9 (implementation), not this schema-definition item.

repo.description: GitHub repository, as owner/name (e.g. "kp080681/my-app"). Must already be selectable in this workspace's connected GitHub installation.

branch.description: Branch to deploy. Omit to use the repository's default branch.

status.description: queued: deployment has started and the agent should poll get_status. needs_configuration: analysis succeeded but required secrets are missing — see missingConfig. blocked: this app is currently paused or rate-limited; see message.

missingConfig.description: Present only when status is needs_configuration.

key.description: The exact environment variable name detected in source, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY. Not translatable to plain language — pass it to set_env verbatim.

public.description: True for NEXT_PUBLIC_-style values exposed to the browser, not secret.

message.description: One plain-language sentence describing what just happened or what to do next.

url.description: Live URL, present only once status becomes live via get_status — always null immediately after deploy.

errors.note: Wait and retry; see rate-limit.mjs, 30/hour for repository analysis, 20/hour for redeploy.
See deployment-failure-cooldown.mjs — this app failed repeatedly and needs manual resume by the workspace owner, not the agent.
Repository is not a supported V1 Next.js or Node.js project.
Repo isn't selected/available in this workspace's GitHub connection.
